summary: Preserve release compatibility proofs across the one-way privacy floor

schema.detail: No storage format, migration or privacy-fence changes.

compatibility.detail: Judging, verdict-index, blob, retired-mail and work-wake probes now require obsolete-reader refusal at the privacy floor. Release-owned archives retain pre-upgrade old-reader proofs; current-build recovery retains post-upgrade verdict, blob, retirement and mixed-wake assertions. The work-wake legacy claim is authored through the pinned release's native claims API and imported through real fleet replication; this tests mixed-store graph precedence, not old reconciler-generated scheduling. Old readers do not consume post-upgrade state.

manual.detail: The optional provenance compatibility fixture remains caller-qualified via ST3_PROVENANCE_COMPAT_BIN, with no repository-owned pinned binary or CI selection. Older provenance support alone does not establish ability to open storage28; that fixture is unchanged.

recovery.detail: Rollback across the privacy floor requires restoring a pre-upgrade backup, not opening upgraded state with an old reader.
